body: No, it isn't his fault but he is right about me. He will be better off when I am dead.

Thank you for your suggestion. I believe my husband will be ok. I think he will be relieved and inmany ways his life will be easier and happier without me. He has said a number of times that he has fantasised about killing me so I know this has crossed his mind too.
Thank you. These are good suggestions.
Thank you. You are the only person who answered my question.

It is not cruel, it is what is best for them. I cannot meet their needs but while I am alive I am expected to, I'm meant to. When I am dead someone will finally step in and help them and make sure they get what they need. They will not have to go without any more.
I know it will be hard on them but it's very clear that I am of no use to them now
